## CAD Engineering Review Checklist

Please ensure the following criteria have been met before requesting a review:

- [ ] **Validation Rules Passed**: The CAD file meets all engineering tolerance rules (e.g., minimum wall thickness).
- [ ] **Metadata Intact**: Layers and block definitions are correctly named according to internal standards.
- [ ] **AI Risk Score**: The AI-generated risk score is below the defined threshold (or exceptions are explicitly documented).
- [ ] **Anomaly Check**: No critical dimensions have changed by >10% without an attached Engineering Change Request (ECR) ticket.

### Description of Changes
_Briefly explain the rationale behind these CAD modifications._
